source: Cases for human_ask.py rules shared with cheese-work/multica-dotfiles (CHE-2597). 'refuse' lists the [line, message] pairs of the addressee-mention and opening-line rules; 'warn' lists those of the format rules (Steps, Checked, Done when, placeholder, bare UUID, implicit words, merge readiness). Expected values come from running human_ask.py check.

opening line 1 needs What this is: with context on the same line
